name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.32.5: a lease claim can refuse to be partial. POST /api/v1/leases/claim accepts allOrNothing; when any machine type has fewer units available than requested, it claims none and answers 409 insufficient_stock with the shortfall, and remembers nothing under requestId, so a later retry claims cleanly once stock is added or freed. Without the flag it behaves as before (claims what exists and warns). The skraning Worker sends it, because a contract that went out with the serial numbers missing was the failure this prevents. Cumulative over v6.32.4.
